default.comment: ADR-0072 D13 — the Action role (ADR-0065 D2): the edge a control takes under the pointer and the icon that answers it. Federation Green at the point of interaction, the same value in every theme

plate.comment: ADR-0085 D6.1 — the ground behind a third-party mark. Supplied logos arrive on an opaque white ground, so the plate stays white in every list; on a neutral ground its edge is --color-border-strong

pinned-edge.comment: ADR-0086 D3 - the pinned sponsor's edge. #D4A017 measures 8.84:1 on the black register (#000000), well over the 3:1 a non-text mark needs. Deliberately NOT --color-semantic-medal-gold: gold is the medal reference (TDR-002) and a pinned sponsor is a commercial arrangement, not an achievement; that token also fails this register in high contrast at 2.45:1. Never colour alone - the edge is --border-width-thick where every other item's is default, and the tier line names it in words

marker.comment: ADR-0072 D13 — the location pin on a map card. It stands on map imagery, an unknown ground, so its value does not follow the theme (contact-map.tsx): the same red in every list, measured on the pin card's base ground

secondary.comment: ADR-0059 — was .600. Shifted one step down so the whole ladder clears AA on every surface, not only on white; 9.04 / 9.04 / 8.22 on base/raised/sunken

muted.comment: ADR-0059 — was .500 (#757470), which measured 4.68:1 on white but 4.48:1 on surface.sunken: an AA failure on the most-used surface in the product (15 call sites), never caught because the original check only ever ran against white. .600 measures 6.32 / 6.32 / 5.75

disabled.comment: Deliberately below 4.5:1 — WCAG 1.4.3 exempts inactive UI components, and the dimming is the affordance

on-brand.comment: ADR-0059 — text on any filled brand or semantic ground. Was referenced by role-workbench.tsx and never defined, so the Archive-role button's label resolved by inheritance over a #D32F2F fill. White measures 4.98 on semantic.error, 4.81 on brand.primary, 5.88 on brand.secondary

link.comment: ADR-0063 — measures 6.38 / 6.67 / 6.07 on base/raised/sunken. Not {color.brand.primary}: the identity value is fixed at Pantone 348 C and measures 4.37:1 on surface.sunken, which is why this role is separate from it

base.comment: ADR-0059 — was {color.white}, identical to `raised`, which left the light theme with no elevation ramp at all (§3.33.1 logged this as a Known Constraint). The page now sits one step below the cards it carries

raised.comment: ADR-0059 — cards/panels, now genuinely lighter than the page ground

sunken.comment: ADR-0059 — was .50, which after the base change would have been indistinguishable from it

section.comment: ADR-0059 — full-bleed identity grounds. Guide §6.1 presents white, red, green and black as the four official backgrounds; §3.34.1 previously forbade the middle two. Green and red are identical across themes because their hue carries them against either page ground; black is the one register that changes, because pure black on a near-black page measures 1.12:1 and stops being a departure at all.

surface.comment: Not green.500: the identity value stays the brand mark's reference per Chapter 1 ("use the official values literally as the 500 reference"), while a ground carrying two tiers of text needs the step Chapter 1 itself names for higher contrast. white measures 4.81 on .500 versus 9.40 on .700

border.comment: 3.29:1 — clears WCAG 1.4.11 for a control boundary inside the section

divider.comment: 1.95:1 — a decorative rule, never a control boundary

surface.comment: white measures 5.88 on red.500 versus 8.14 on .600

border.comment: 8.14:1. No step of the red ramp reaches 3:1 against red.600 without turning pink, so the control boundary here is white — which is also what the guide's own red materials use (white strokes on the referee kit §2.3 and every local-championship garment)

adjacent-separator.comment: ADR-0059 — MANDATORY between a green and a red section. Measured contrast between the two registers is 1.15:1: stacked directly they have no visible boundary whatsoever, and the pair is the classic red/green confusion besides. The guide never abuts them either — in the four-stroke motif there is always white or black between

accent.comment: ADR-0072 D3 — the accent rule: the short dash before a label and the pull-quote's edge. 4.61 / 4.81 / 4.38 on base / raised / sunken, a shape at 3

subtle.comment: ADR-0059 — row separators inside dense tables, where `default` reads as a grid of boxes. Was referenced by permission-catalogue-lens.tsx and never defined, so every one of its 170 row rules fell back to currentColor

strong.comment: 4.68 on white, 4.48 on base, 4.25 on sunken — clears WCAG 1.4.11 non-text 3:1 on all three

default.comment: ADR-0051 — new, independent of color.brand.primary per Brand Guide v1.0 §9 (must contrast against green/red/neutral element backgrounds alike)

offset.comment: ADR-0051 — halo/offset ring, ensures visibility of focus.default against any background including green.500/red.500

success.comment: ADR-0051 — independent hue, no longer aliases color.brand.primary

error.comment: ADR-0051 — renamed from `danger`, independent hue, no longer aliases color.brand.secondary

warning.comment: ADR-0071 D1 — was .500 (#D09E07), 2.34 / 2.45 / 2.23 on base/raised/sunken: under WCAG 1.4.11's 3:1 as an icon or an edge. .600 measures 3.24 / 3.39 / 3.08. A shape colour: warning text is warning-text

success-text.comment: ADR-0071 D1 — the state as text. success itself measures 3.98 on sunken, a shape colour. .600 measures 5.87 / 6.14 / 5.58 on base/raised/sunken

error-text.comment: ADR-0071 D1 — the state as text; closes ADR-0067's DESIGN SYSTEM GAP. 4.77 / 4.98 / 4.53 on base/raised/sunken

warning-text.comment: ADR-0071 D1 — the state as text. 5.15 / 5.38 / 4.90 on base/raised/sunken

info-text.comment: ADR-0071 D1 — the state as text. info itself measures 3.91 on sunken, a shape colour. .600 measures 5.07 / 5.30 / 4.81 on base/raised/sunken

surface.comment: ADR-0072 D1 — item 1 of a closed set: the card's ground, under the title, the description and the ink

ink.comment: ADR-0072 D1 — the item's number and icon. The darkest green: every step from .300 to .700 stands under 15 from the success colours for a deuteranope or protanope, and .800 falls within 10 of desert sand's ink

edge.comment: ADR-0072 D1 — the card's edge: its own ground where colour carries the item, drawn in high contrast

surface.comment: ADR-0072 D1 — item 2 of a closed set: the card's ground, under the title, the description and the ink

ink.comment: ADR-0072 D1 — the item's number and icon. Not .700, which is category 2 itself

edge.comment: ADR-0072 D1 — the card's edge: its own ground where colour carries the item, drawn in high contrast

surface.comment: ADR-0072 D1 — item 3 of a closed set: the card's ground, under the title, the description and the ink

ink.comment: ADR-0072 D1 — the item's number and icon. Not .500, which stands under 15 from the info colours

edge.comment: ADR-0072 D1 — the card's edge: its own ground where colour carries the item, drawn in high contrast

surface.comment: ADR-0072 D1 — item 4 of a closed set: the card's ground, under the title, the description and the ink

ink.comment: ADR-0072 D1 — the item's number and icon. Not .500 to .700, which stand under 15 from the warning colours

edge.comment: ADR-0072 D1 — the card's edge: its own ground where colour carries the item, drawn in high contrast

panel.comment: ADR-0066 — a large container standing IN the flow, not floating above it. It borrowed {elevation.dropdown} before this token existed: the right value under a name that described a different object, which is how a component ends up documented as a menu.

panel-hover.comment: ADR-0066 — one rung deeper than a card's hover, because a panel is larger and the same shadow reads as less lift on more area.

ring.comment: ADR-0051 — repointed from {color.brand.primary} per Brand Guide v1.0 §9
